question: Which of the following folk dances is associated with Jammu and Kashmir?
solution:
The correct answer is __Kud.__​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Kud dance is a ritual to honour the Kul Devtas or Lok Devatas or the Gods of the people. 
 
• Kud dance is another form of dance that is practised mainly near the middle mountain areas of Jammu and Kashmir.
